notes: Every tutor reply is now inspected before you see it. One arrived with a Russian word in it and the tutor talking to itself about switching back to Croatian; that reply is now thrown away and asked for again, and if the second attempt is also bad you get an honest message instead of nonsense. The chat follows the keyboard so the last message stays visible, the keyboard closes when you send, and the first message no longer sits against the top bar. The switch is now 'Teach me in English', and with it on the tutor will never hand you the answer it is asking you to write. With it off, it is told exactly how many words you have met so far and to stay inside them, so switching it off early no longer buries you.
